high_level_description: The image depicts a person dressed in a Minnie Mouse costume. The outfit consists of a black strapless top with a pink polka-dotted bow at the center, a matching pink skirt adorned with white polka dots, and a white lace trim at the hem. The person is also wearing black knee-high boots. They have long, dark hair styled down and are accessorized with large hoop earrings and a pink polka-dotted bow headband that matches the outfit.
